title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
author: Soheil Abbasloo, Peng Cheng
description: arXiv:2611.17563v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong.
